question:
Access model: How do guests reach a shared calendar?
Why it matters: Decides whether guests need an account.
Depends on: Storage.
Signed link — Pro: No account needed · Con: Hard to revoke per person
Guest account — Pro: Revocable per person · Con: Sign-up friction
